intro: This errand introduces adventurers to Ironforge's gryphon network by tasking them with carrying a bundle of ceremonial tools to the city's gryphon master. Entrusted with the Honorary Picks by Golnir Bouldertoe, the courier must deliver them to Gryth Thurden so they can be dispatched back to Loch Modan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here are the honorary picks for Brock's students. If you've already been to Thelsamar, then you should fly a gryphon back there!
Take the picks to our gryphon master, Gryth Thurden, and speak with him about a ride back to Thelsamar.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look like you have somewhere to go. Need one of my gryphons?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have to get these to Thelsamar, eh? That won't be a problem. As long as you've already been to Thelsamar and spoken to Thorgrum Borrelson, then you can take one of my gryphons back to him.
